minecraft:written_book_content.author: M. Ashdown, Clerk
pages: {"text": "Gatehouse register, Beyond.\n\nTwelve frames set, twelve eyes seated. Draught from Beyond runs cold and clean, cleaner than Below. The Guild is pleased."}
{"text": "The cold does not leave the sanctum when the gate is shut. Frost on the inside of the frames in summer.\n\nThree of the fitters report they have stopped dreaming. Recorded."}
{"text": "Something came back through with the draught. Not a creature. A presence in the room, like being watched by someone politely.\n\nThe staff call them lodgers. I have asked them to stop."}
{"text": "Doctor Marsh writes from the far station that we are not drawing power. We are being drawn on.\n\nThe Guild has asked me to stop recording her letters."}
